facts.fact: On 2026-09-08 Algerie Telecom and Niger Telecom signed a convention in Niamey under which Algerie Telecom donates fibre-optic transmission equipment to set up an Agadez-Assamaka fibre link, to the Algerian border, with an initial capacity of 100 gigabits; the article also reports Niger Telecom receiving the equipment, and does not report works begun or the link lit.
facts.system: Agadez-Assamaka fibre link (Niger-Algeria trans-Saharan fibre-optic backbone)
